description: PWA support, mobile polish, safety features, loading/empty/error states, offline fallback, and final demo flow verification. Make the app installable, polished on mobile, and handle all edge cases.
steps: Create public/manifest.json - PWA manifest with name: SpartanCircle, short_name: SpartanCircle, start_url: /dashboard, display: standalone, theme_color: #0055A2, background_color: #ffffff, icons array with placeholder icons at 192x192 and 512x512.
Create public/icons/icon-192x192.png and public/icons/icon-512x512.png - Simple placeholder icons (can be generated SVG-based or solid color with SC text).
Create public/sw.js or src/app/service-worker.ts - Basic service worker that caches the offline fallback page and serves it when network is unavailable.

Create src/app/offline/page.tsx - Offline fallback page with friendly message: 'You appear to be offline. SpartanCircle needs an internet connection to sync your matches and messages. Your data will be here when you reconnect.' Include SJSU blue styling.
Add PWA meta tags to src/app/layout.tsx: link rel=manifest, meta name=theme-color, meta name=apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-touch-icon link.
Register service worker in src/app/layout.tsx or a client component that runs on mount.
Create src/components/ui/loading-skeleton.tsx - Reusable skeleton loader component for cards, lists, and pages.

Create src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx - Reusable empty state component with icon, title, description, and optional CTA button. Use for: no matches, no pods, no events, no conversations, no availability set.
Create src/components/ui/error-state.tsx - Reusable error state component for: access denied, not found, network error, AI failure.

Add loading.tsx files in key route groups: src/app/(main)/dashboard/loading.tsx, src/app/(main)/matches/loading.tsx, src/app/(main)/pods/loading.tsx, src/app/(main)/chat/loading.tsx, src/app/(main)/events/loading.tsx - each with appropriate skeleton layouts.
Add error.tsx files in key route groups with the error-state component.
Add not-found.tsx at app level and in dynamic routes ([id] pages).
Ensure all interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile.
Review all pages for mobile responsiveness: proper padding (px-4 on mobile), readable font sizes (min 14px body), no horizontal overflow, proper spacing between elements.
Ensure mobile bottom nav is fixed at bottom, does not overlap content (add pb-16 to main content area), and has proper safe-area-inset padding for notched phones.
Implement block user flow: from match card/detail or chat, user can block. Blocked users are filtered from matches, pods, chats, and events context throughout the app.
Implement report flow: report dialog with reason (spam, harassment, inappropriate, other) and optional description. Stores in reports collection.
Implement leave conversation: from chat header menu, confirm dialog, then remove user from conversation members.
Implement hide profile toggle: from settings/privacy, hides user from all matching results for others.
Add proper focus states, aria-labels, and keyboard navigation for accessibility basics.

Final pass: ensure the complete demo flow works end-to-end: landing -> demo login -> dashboard -> top match -> match detail -> conversation starter -> send message -> pods -> join pod -> pod chat -> events -> RSVP -> mobile navigation between all sections.
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json is valid and app is installable (Add to Home Screen prompt possible)
Offline fallback page renders when network is unavailable
All pages have loading skeleton states
Empty states render with friendly messages and CTAs
Error states handle 404, access denied, and network errors
Mobile bottom nav is fixed and does not overlap content
Block user removes them from all visible contexts
Leave conversation removes user and navigates back
Hide profile toggle prevents user from appearing in others' matches
Complete demo flow works without errors from landing to RSVP
findings: All 52 tests pass. Build succeeds cleanly. PWA manifest valid with start_url /dashboard, standalone display. Service worker handles offline navigation with network-first strategy. Icons are solid SJSU blue PNG placeholders (192x192, 512x512). Block filtering integrated into matches and dashboard pages via getHiddenUserIds helper. Privacy settings page shows blocked users with unblock option. Block-report dialog enhanced with optional description textarea. Bottom nav already had safe-area-inset-bottom support. All error.tsx files use client directive as required by Next.js. Button component uses base-ui and does not support asChild - used Link component directly instead for href-based CTAs in empty-state.
